svg.text: Thirty-one country names withdrawn from ISO 3166 since 1974, and the five places one could still be.
A name survives where the addresses are cheap. Where they are scarce it is evicted, and no policy prevents it.
Burma, Socialist Republic of the Union of
USSR, Union of Soviet Socialist Republics
ISO 3166:1988 — the edition RFC 1766 cited in 1995, and therefore the floor of the IANA registry's memory
it is not — and never was removed, only never entered
the address exists and another country is in it
(last two columns) the address is still vacant — nobody has been let in
Sources: ISO 3166-3 and ISO 3166-1 via the iso-codes compilation; the IANA Language Subtag Registry, File-Date 2026-08-08; CLDR territoryAlias.
Measured offline by measure.py from files hashed in sources/MANIFEST.json. Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 56, 2026-08-14.
